Returns the RBAC-aware UI action for adding a role to the current object.
The response contains an active Add role button only when the current actor
has the create operation on the target RBAC object; otherwise it renders a
disabled action and no dialog-loading URL is exposed.

Returns the Bootstrap dialog content used to create a time-limited role
directly on the current RBAC object. User and role-type choices are loaded
lazily from their standard secured list endpoints using Hasura-like where filters.

post.description:
Creates a role on the selected RBAC object with an explicit validity interval
and redirects the browser to the page from which role creation was initiated.

get.description: Shows root RBAC role assignments and creation scopes; only readable by an actor with Read on Root.

post.description: Creates a user inside group_id and immediately creates its Membership. Create permission is evaluated on the target Group; no client-supplied RBAC object is accepted.

Returns the contextual action menu for a User. Standard View/Edit/Delete actions are combined with relation actions. Enabled state is calculated from the acting user's RBAC permissions; target-dependent relation actions are enabled only when at least one permitted target Group exists.

Lists secured users. Optional `where` accepts a JSON Hasura-like filter expression
that is translated to an IQueryable predicate before database materialization. Optional `take`
limits the result to 1..200 rows and is intended for selectors and incremental lookup UI.
